tools.name: get_api_credit_balance
tools.description: API credit balance: prepaid credits left for SEO data calls, amount spent, whether spending is suspended, and the per-call pricing rule. Free; no supplier call.

tools.name: get_ai_overview_sources
tools.description: AI Overview sources: whether Google shows an AI Overview for a keyword, its text, every page it cites, and whether a given domain is cited. Costs API credits per call.

tools.name: check_chatgpt_brand_mentions
tools.description: ChatGPT brand mentions: ask ChatGPT (with web search) a buyer's question and report whether it mentions your brand, which sources it cites, and whether your domain is cited. Costs API credits per call.

tools.name: check_perplexity_brand_mentions
tools.description: Perplexity brand mentions: ask Perplexity a buyer's question and report whether it mentions your brand, which sources it cites, and whether your domain is cited. Costs API credits per call.
